responsibility: Declares the parser context and entry points for the diagnostics output-spec DSL used to add or replace sinks from option strings. It defines the abstract reporting/open-file interface used during parsing, plus dc_spec_context for routing parse errors through a diagnostics::context at a source location, forming the API boundary above the concrete scheme parsing and sink-factory implementation in output-spec.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the API boundary for the output-spec pair: it declares the abstract context and dc_spec_context used to report parse errors and open files, while output-spec.cc implements the DSL parser and concrete scheme-to-sink factory logic.
